article_manifest.title: Sahel: The number of displaced in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger has almost doubled since 2020, according to UNHCR
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel: le nombre de déplacés au Burkina Faso, au Mali et au Niger a presque doublé depuis 2020, selon le HCR
article_manifest.summary: The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) warns of the displacement crisis in the Sahel: Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger now have nearly 4 million displaced persons and refugees, almost twice as many as in 2020, the year of the first military coup in Bamako . Published on: In Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, “security incidents have nearly doubled since 2020, weakening the state presence […] and increasing risks for both displaced people and host communities,” said Abdouraouf Gnon-Konde, UNHCR's Director for West and Central Africa, on Friday, 9 October .

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niger Intelligence Agents Expelled From France in Sign of Diplomatic Strain
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Niger Intelligence Agents Expelled From France in Sign of Diplomatic Strain
article_manifest.summary: Two Nigerien intelligence officers were forced to leave France last month, French daily Le Monde has revealed, with one agent suspected of monitoring opposition figures on French soil. It is the latest sign of the deterioration in relations between the two countries since Niger's 2023 military coup. France expelled two Nigerien intelligence officers posted at Niger's embassy in Paris last month, a diplomatic source told French news agency AFP.

article_manifest.title: Fuel supply: 5,396 tankers arrived in Bamako since September
article_manifest.original_title: Approvisionnement en carburant : 5 396 camions-citernes arrivés à Bamako depuis septembre
article_manifest.summary: Fuel supply: 5,396 tanker trucks arrived in Bamako since September A new convoy of 957 tanker trucks arrived in Bamako this Saturday, October 10, 2026, under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), according to the Directorate General of Trade, Consumption and Competition (DGCC). In September, the capital recorded the arrival of 3,796 tanker trucks divided into five convoys .

article_manifest.title: Burkina: suspension of flour exports
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina : suspension des exportations de farine
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso has suspended until further notice the export of millet, maize and sorghum flour, as well as their derivatives, to ensure their availability on the national market, according to an official statement consulted on Saturday . A measure to freeze exports of millet, maize and sorghum flour was announced by the Burkinabe authorities in a press release dated 9 October and signed by the Minister of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts, Serge Gnaniodem Poda.

article_manifest.title: Traditional chieftaincy: Mr. Bachir Sadou Kalilou elected 16th chief of canton of Sakoira
article_manifest.original_title: Chefferie traditionnelle : M. Bachir Sadou Kalilou élu 16ᵉ chef de canton de Sakoira
article_manifest.summary: Tillabéri, 10 Oct (ANP) – Mr. Bachir Sadou Kalilou, was elected this Saturday, October 10, 2026, unanimously by his peers, 16th head of canton of Sakoira, a rural commune attached to the department of Tillabéri .

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Tenenkou: 14 tons of food will be distributed to 231 vulnerable households
article_manifest.original_title: Tenenkou : 14 tonnes de vivres seront distribuées à 231 ménages vulnérables
article_manifest.summary: Tenenkou, 10 October (AMAP) A total of 14 tonnes of millet will be distributed to 231 vulnerable households, or 1,389 beneficiaries in the urban commune of Tenenkou, as part of the national food insecurity response plan. The launch ceremony of this operation was held Saturday in front of the town hall, under the chairmanship of the 2nd deputy to the prefect, the Chief Commissioner of Police Ousmane Diamouténé, noted AMAP .

article_manifest.title: Mali.. Army targets two vehicles in Kidal and Timbuktu base
article_manifest.original_title: مالي.. الجيش يستهدف مركبتين في كيدال وقاعدة بتمبكتو
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Army announced the targeting of two vehicles that it said were transporting "armed elements" southwest of Kidal city, in addition to carrying out an airstrike that targeted a base that includes armed elements and military and logistical equipment in the Ndaki area in Timbuktu state. He said in a statement issued on Friday evening that the two vehicles were spotted 45 and 46 kilometers southwest of Kidal during the ongoing military operations in the eastern region.

article_manifest.title: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: the return of the flag, the return
article_manifest.original_title: GOONGA TAN : Kidal : le retour du drapeau, le retour
article_manifest.summary: Mali finds Kidal. But beyond a military victory, it is a political, historical and symbolic battle that changes its nature. Indeed, this Tuesday, October 6, 2026 will undoubtedly remain as one of the highlights of Mali's recent history .

article_manifest.title: Mali: The national flag now flies in the sky of Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Le drapeau national flotte désormais dans le ciel de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: Kidal, the strategic city in northern Mali has been back in the fold of the state since Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The Malian Armed Forces (Fama) and their Russian allies have indeed managed to take control of this megalopolis after a major military offensive . To mark the total and entire membership of the Ifoghas city in the Republic of Mali, the national flag was raised on its public buildings.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike hard in Kidal and Timbuktu
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : Les FAMa frappent fort à Kidal et Tombouctou
article_manifest.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strikes hard in Kidal and Timbuktu Two surgical strikes conducted by FAMa, with the support of their partners, neutralized terrorist elements in the Eastern and Central regions as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Eastern Theater: This Friday, October 9, 2026, two vehicles carrying terrorists were spotted 45 and 46 km southwest of Kidal .

article_manifest.title: Zinder: eleven suspects arrested after the dismantling of two criminal networks
article_manifest.original_title: Zinder : onze suspects interpellés après le démantèlement de deux réseaux criminels
article_manifest.summary: Eleven individuals arrested, fifteen victims identified and three people actively wanted: the dismantling of two criminal networks by the Zinder Interregional Criminal Police Service reveals serial robberies in homes and markets, as well as a concealment circuit linking Zinder, Maradi and the surroundings of Takeita. The case started with an abandoned motorcycle in the Jacques Chirac district of Zinder .

article_manifest.title: 7 Mali: The takeover of Kidal "consolidates" the Transition
article_manifest.original_title: 7 Mali: La reprise de Kidal «consolide» la Transition
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps reinvested Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal, in the north of the country, less than six months after being driven out by the separatists of the Fla and their jihadist allies of the Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. This prestigious victory was achieved without even having to fight, as the armed groups withdrew before the arrival of the army .
